title: WebPro
subtitle: Web Development Masterclass
description: An interactive educational application designed to help users learn web development through structured lessons, practical examples and guided learning.
statement: A mobile-focused learning platform designed to make web development education accessible, organised and engaging.
problem: Learning web development can be overwhelming for beginners, particularly when information is spread across multiple websites, tutorials and documentation sources. Without a clear learning structure, users may struggle to understand which topics to study first.

Many learning resources also focus heavily on theory without providing enough practical context. This can make it difficult for learners to connect concepts and develop confidence in applying their knowledge.
solution: WebPro brings web development learning into a structured application, organising educational content into clear topics and progressive learning levels.
The application is being developed to provide detailed explanations, practical examples and an intuitive navigation system, allowing learners to explore subjects at their own pace.
design: The interface follows a mobile-first approach, prioritising readable content, straightforward navigation and a consistent learning experience.
Clear typography, organised content sections and reusable interface components help users navigate between learning topics while maintaining a familiar visual structure.

designPoints.title: Structured learning
designPoints.text: Organises web development subjects into logical topics and learning levels.

designPoints.title: Consistent navigation
designPoints.text: Uses a familiar navigation structure to make moving between learning sections straightforward.

designPoints.title: Mobile-first interface
designPoints.text: Prioritises comfortable reading, accessible controls and clear presentation on smaller screens.

development: WebPro is being developed as an interactive educational application, with an emphasis on reusable components, structured learning content and maintainable application architecture.
The development process focuses on creating a consistent interface, organising educational material and preparing the application for additional interactive learning functionality.
outcome: WebPro is currently in development, with the aim of providing a comprehensive and accessible environment for learning web development.
The project demonstrates an approach to building educational applications that combine structured content, interface consistency and practical learning experiences.

title: Cookbook
subtitle: Your Favourite Recipes
description: A recipe application designed to help users explore, organise and access their favourite meals through a simple and intuitive mobile interface.
statement: A mobile-friendly recipe collection designed to make finding and following favourite recipes straightforward and enjoyable.
problem: Recipes are often scattered across websites, bookmarks and personal notes, making it difficult to locate a particular meal when needed. Many recipe websites also contain lengthy introductions and distracting elements that interrupt the cooking experience.
When using a phone in the kitchen, complicated navigation, small text and poorly organised instructions can make following recipes unnecessarily frustrating.
solution: Cookbook is designed to bring recipes together in a clear, organised interface where users can browse meals and access relevant cooking information.
The application focuses on straightforward navigation and readable recipe content, helping users move between ingredients and preparation instructions with minimal distraction.
design: The design prioritises food imagery, clear typography and a straightforward content hierarchy, making individual recipes easy to recognise and explore.
Recipe information is organised into distinct sections, with attention to spacing, readability and mobile usability so users can comfortably follow instructions while preparing meals.

designPoints.title: Recipe organisation
designPoints.text: Presents recipes in a clear structure that makes meals easier to browse and discover.

designPoints.title: Visual presentation
designPoints.text: Uses food imagery and readable typography to create an inviting recipe browsing experience.

designPoints.title: Easy-to-follow instructions
designPoints.text: Separates ingredients and preparation steps to improve clarity during cooking.

development: Cookbook is being developed with a focus on reusable interface components and structured recipe data, allowing recipe information to be presented consistently throughout the application.
The development approach prioritises responsive layouts, straightforward navigation and a maintainable foundation for future recipe management functionality.
outcome: Cookbook is currently in development, with the goal of delivering an accessible and visually engaging recipe browsing experience.
The project explores how structured content, thoughtful interface design and reusable components can make everyday information easier to access and use.
